name: EmbodiedLab
summary: Evaluates embodied agents on quantitative science experiments in a simulated laboratory, in which the agent selects its own procedure and parameters are resampled for each instance.
numbers: 30 experiments, 5 disciplines, 14 apparatus platforms; 6 frontier models

why.cog: Chooses its own procedure and reasons from readings.
why.xr: Capability precursor for experimental uplift; no misuse layer.
